content_html:
This post seems to contradict the part about not having to uninstall Beta1:

http://blogs.msdn.com/AskBurton/archive/2004/09/01/224392.aspx

Q: Can I install Visual Studio 2005 Beta 1 Refresh with Visual Studio 2005 Team System on top of Visual Studio 2005 Beta 1?
A: No. To install Visual Studio 2005 Beta 1 Refresh with Visual Studio 2005 Team System, you must first uninstall Visual Studio 2005 Beta 1.

Yeah, I read the Team System’s blog. What I meant was that there is no reason to install this refresh at all unless I still want to try out Team System. Since right now I’m only using VS Beta 1, I’m not going to do anything. I’ll just continue using the build I have because it’s the same build as this new release.

RE: this item – " Also, if I had downloaded the CTP of VSTS several months ago, then I already have what’s in these bits."

That’s not the case. The Team System bits in this CTP are different than the bits from the May CTP.
Good to know, but the VS 2005 bits are the same, right?

SQL Server Beta 2 folks might find this useful [1]. This also seems consistent w/ the assertion that VS.NET 2005 is the same coz I have 2.0.40607 installed right now. I am just going to blow off VS.NET 2005 and try to install the Refresh from scratch and hopefully my machine will come out of it in one piece :).

[1]:
Thomas’ Tip: VS 2005 Beta 1 Refresh uses the most recent build (40607.85) of the .NET Framework, and so must be installed prior to SQL Server 2005 Beta 2 (which includes the older 40607.42). SQL Server Beta 2 will see that the .NET Framework is already installed and just go with that version.
